title: Failed runs kept as carefully as successful ones (D2, P3)
request: From Hermes Agent the owner wants failed runs kept as carefully as successful ones: 'what went wrong' is training data too. The audit of 2026-10-23 had found 62 failed self-play solves and online_shoppers' failed solver run thrown away: self-play wrote a failed engine solve only as a reason line, and the M5 set builder only counted unverified trajectories.
spec: Plan D2 whole step record, package P3 (plans/yes-you-are-right-jaunty-parasol.md): failed_solves.jsonl beside the verified solves; the folder trajectories/failed with why in each submission; frontier failures to silver with the same why; the failed self-play solves as trajectories with what they missed.
plan: read solve() in lake/selfplay.py and place()/build() in store/sets/llm.py
keep_failed: a failed engine solve written whole, the table's cells scrubbed, never the table
place(): a failed run to trajectories/failed (a frontier model's to silver) with why; the table check only for verified runs
self-play: an unverified solve as a trajectory in trajectories/failed with the checks it missed (selfplay_failures)
tests on the self-play loop and the M5 sets; the adversarial review

decisions.decision: A failed engine solve keeps its solution, its stage records (the row-quoting keys scrubbed as the trace scrubs them) and labels, never case.table; the replica's categories and class labels stay, as the verified solves' ledgers keep them
decisions.why: the run object holds the replica's table itself, which is never written; self-play's tables are invented, never a person's

decisions.decision: Library kinds are not written to failed_solves.jsonl
decisions.why: library_solves.jsonl already keeps them whole, verified or not

decisions.decision: A failed run never goes through newest_per_table
decisions.why: a newer failed run would otherwise supersede a verified solve of the same table by the same solver

decisions.decision: The failure check runs before the table check in place()
decisions.why: a run that never reached its holdout has no table; its split followed its session, which is enough for a failed example

decisions.decision: why lives in the trajectory's submission, with verified: false, beside what it had
decisions.why: Provenance has no free field; the submission is where a run's outcome is read

decisions.decision: The session's own ending is named in why when it did not complete
decisions.why: 'not scored' alone hides that the budget ran out or the model wrote its calls as text

change: dclab_rnd/lake/selfplay.py (keep_failed, the solve loop keeps failed engine solves), dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (FAILED, failure_of, as_failed, place, selfplay_failures, build, the session's status on the problem, the folder's about), tests/test_selfplay_kinds.py, tests/test_store_m5_trajectories.py.

findings.defect: a failed engine solve was lost: only its reason reached done.jsonl
findings.scenario: 62 of the self-play solves failed kind.accept; nothing of them was kept
findings.cause: solve() wrote examples only for verified solves
findings.fix: keep_failed writes the solve whole (scrubbed) to failed_solves.jsonl
findings.impact: lost training data on what went wrong
alternatives: re-run the failed solves later (the same cost again)

findings.defect: the M5 builder counted unverified intern trajectories and wrote none
findings.scenario: five fixture sessions (no final, a final never run, one made before, a failed truth, an unjudged truth) were placed nowhere
findings.fix: trajectories/failed with why; frontier failures to silver

findings.defect: with the table check first, every unscored run would have been 'table not known' and still placed nowhere
findings.cause: an unscored run has no holdout, so no table
findings.fix: the failure check first; the table check only for verified runs
findings.impact: the failed set would have stayed empty

findings.defect: a failed run with no holdout on a sealed table landed in trajectories/failed's train split
findings.scenario: a train project whose final ran on the table a sealed project also ran on; its session never scored: table None, so the sealed-table rule never fired
findings.cause: the split followed the session when the holdout was missing
findings.fix: any final of the project names its table for the split (known & sealed_tables); a project with no final at all follows its session, said in the folder's about
findings.impact: a sealed table's description in a training folder (new with P3: before, the run was placed nowhere)
alternatives: refuse to place a run with no final when the workspace has any sealed table
findings.open: a project with no final cannot be tied to its table here

findings.defect: the claim 'never a table's cell value' was false: scrub removes row-quoting keys only; the replica's categories, class labels and one-hot feature names stay in the stage records (26 strings on the binary replica, 170 on the multiclass)
findings.scenario: failed_solves.jsonl holds positive_label 'yes', 'plan=basic', the class labels of a confusion matrix
findings.cause: CELL_KEYS covers rows, not category names
findings.fix: the truth said in keep_failed's docstring, the record and the test: these are invented tables, kept as the verified solves' ledgers and screens keep them
findings.impact: a false claim in the record; no person's data (self-play never runs on a real table)
alternatives: a value-based scrub of every category of case.table (would also blind the record to what the engine chose)

findings.defect: the scrub assertion could not fail: the ranking run's records hold no cell key and no 'sample' key
findings.scenario: the test passed with scrub removed
findings.cause: the test looked for keys the fixture never had
findings.fix: the test plants 'examples' under a stage record and asserts it is gone while a sibling key stays

findings.defect: forget() left a kind's lines in failed_solves.jsonl
findings.scenario: forget then solve again: the stale failed line stays and selfplay_failures still names the group
findings.cause: the file was not in forget's list
findings.fix: failed_solves.jsonl added to forget's list of files, keyed by group
findings.impact: a stale failure beside a verified solve

findings.defect: the kept reason of a solve whose checks broke was cut to 200 characters, with no traceback
findings.cause: one string served the log line and the record
findings.fix: the whole error and traceback.format_exc() in failed_solves.jsonl; the log line keeps its short form
findings.impact: the owner's rule: never truncate before saving

measurements.name: the self-play loop and the M5 set tests
measurements.gate: every test passes; studio's rows unchanged
measurements.result: every test in the two files passed, the new ones included; studio's rows are the same as before
measurements.next: make capture, then the failed folder's counts; the full gate tonight
limits: the real self-play failures are written only by the next self-play run: the past ones left no solve to keep

outcome: A failed engine solve is kept whole beside the verified ones, and every failed run (intern or self-play) is a trajectory in trajectories/failed with why and what it missed; studio holds only verified solves.
lessons: Check the order of refusals: a rule that fires first can empty the set a later rule was written for.
A failed run must not compete with a verified one for 'newest': keep the two paths apart.
risks: the 62 failed solves already counted left no solve behind: only solves from now on are kept whole
the failed folder's consent is train: a frontier model's failed run is routed to silver by its answerer, so a mis-read answerer would land it in a training folder (the same risk as studio's)
